name: Los Angeles AFB
description: Los Angeles SFB is headquarters for Space Systems Command (SSC) and Space Base Delta 3 — a compact urban installation in the South Bay with no flightline. On-base family housing, recreation, and the Fort MacArthur housing annex in San Pedro (~20 miles south) are managed separately from the El Segundo campus.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a pass through the Visitor Control Center at Douglas Street Gate.

gates.name: Douglas Street Gate (Main)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate and main visitor access point. Visitor Control Center (Bldg 260) is located immediately left of the entrance. REAL ID required for visitors.
gates.address: 200 N Douglas St, El Segundo, CA 90245

gates.name: Aviation Boulevard Gate
gates.notes: Closed weekends and federal holidays. Commuter gate for El Segundo campus personnel.
gates.address: 483 N Aviation Blvd, El Segundo, CA 90245

gates.name: Fort MacArthur 24th Street Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Fort MacArthur housing annex. Temporary visitor passes for housing areas issued at gate; may be delayed based on patrol response.
gates.address: 24th St, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

gates.name: Fort MacArthur 30th Street Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Fort MacArthur housing and community facilities in San Pedro.
gates.address: 30th St, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

gates.name: Pacific Heights Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Pacific Heights housing area. Restricted to authorized military and DoD ID cardholders and registered visitors.

gates.name: Pacific Crest Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 access to Pacific Crest housing area. Restricted to authorized military and DoD ID cardholders and registered visitors.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Douglas Street Gate)
gates.notes: Issues temporary visitor passes, vehicle passes, and DBIDS credentials. Closed weekends, federal holidays, and family days. Fort MacArthur housing visitor passes issued 24/7 at housing gates.
gates.address: Bldg 260, Douglas Street Gate, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.name: No Traditional Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Los Angeles SFB has no traditional military dining facility. Meals are available at the South Bay Bar & Grill, BX food court, and Fort MacArthur Community Center / Harbor View Lounge. Unaccompanied housing residents receive BAS.
resources.address: Los Angeles SFB, El Segundo, CA 90245

resources.hours: Mon-Fri 1100-1400 lunch; Fri lounge 1700-2100; see lafss.com for events
resources.address: 210 W 29th St, Bldg 403, Fort MacArthur, San Pedro, CA 90731

resources.name: BX Food Court

resources.name: Los Angeles SFB Main Exchange (BX)

primaryAction.title: Los Angeles SFB Visitor Control Center
primaryAction.address: Bldg 260, Douglas Street Gate, El Segundo, CA 90245

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit at the El Segundo campus normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Visit the Military Personnel Flight in Bldg 272 for ID cards and personnel actions. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: There is no on-base family housing at El Segundo. Permanent housing is at Fort MacArthur (Tierra Vista Communities) and Pacific Heights/Crest neighborhoods in San Pedro. Fort MacArthur Inn offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season. Visit the Housing Referral Office before signing any off-base lease.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: Douglas Street Gate is open 24/7 and is the main visitor access point. Aviation Boulevard Gate is Mon-Fri 0600-0800 and 1530-1730 only. Fort MacArthur 24th/30th Street gates and Pacific Heights/Crest gates are 24/7 for authorized personnel. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0700-1500. REAL ID required.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus 61st FSS (lafss.com) for dining, fitness, and recreation across El Segundo and Fort MacArthur.
